instruction:
Use the ANSYS Mechanical APDL GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: cantilever beam under harmonic end excitation, find steady-state amplitude.

Model parameters:
- Beam cross section 10 mm x 10 mm, length 500 mm
- Material: Structural Steel, E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3, density 7850 kg/m^3
- Element: BEAM188, rectangular section 10x10 mm
- Mesh: 20 uniform divisions along the length

Boundary conditions and load:
- Fixed end: fully constrained
- Free end: harmonic force F = 10 N, frequency 5 Hz, direction -Y
- Damping: no damping or damping ratio < 0.001

Analysis type: Harmonic response (Full method), solve around 5 Hz

Save requirements:
- Database file: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\apdl_harmonic.db
- Result file (.rst) must exist in the working directory
